summary: Pre-demo E2E validation of Ownology. Ran 14 smoke tests + 42 new demo-critical tests + browser validation of /hi/producers/8, /risk-management, /try. Result: 54/56 pytest pass. The demo-critical path IS READY (cold-prospect page, admin gate, tRPC endpoints, sample vintage log variants, sitemap, health, LLM sandbox all green). Two failures found: (1) /i/:token magic-link invite is BROKEN through the preview URL due to K8s ingress routing — works fine on backend-direct localhost:8001; (2) transient gate rate-limit false-positive from test hammering — not a real bug.

critical.issue: INGRESS ROUTING BUG: The magic-link invite endpoint is defined in Express at /app/server/index.ts:312 and works correctly on http://localhost:8001/i/<token> (returns 302 + sets ow_gate cookie + Location: /admin). But through the preview URL https://private-tutor-2.preview.emergentagent.com/i/<token> it returns 200 HTML (SPA shell) and does NOT set the cookie. Root cause: Kubernetes ingress routes non-/api/* paths to the frontend service (port 3000), so /i/* never reaches Express (port 8001). Fix options: (a) add ingress rule to route /i/* to backend, or (b) move endpoint to /api/i/:token and update the invite URL generation.

minor.issue: Rate limiter (5/15min per IP) is aggressive — legitimate testing/QA hits 429 quickly. Consider allowlisting internal test IPs or bumping window for beta preview. This caused 1 spurious test failure after ~10 verify calls in one session.

Review request referenced gate.createInvite / gate.listInvites / gate.revokeInvite — but actual procedure names are gate.create / gate.list / gate.revoke. Docs/PRD should be updated so team knows correct names.
Review request stated response is { ids: [...] } but actual shape is a list of { id, name } objects. Not a bug — just docs drift.

Review request said response includes coachLine at top level — actual keys are today, dow, hour, season, tasks, weeklyBoard, streak, doneTodayCount, totalTodayCount. coachLine is served by the separate /api/trpc/marketingOps.coachLine endpoint (which works).

integration_issues.issue: See /i/:token ingress bug above — a demo tester who receives an invite link cannot get into the gated app because the route never reaches the backend on the preview URL.

action_items: PRIORITY 1 (demo-critical): Fix /i/:token routing on preview URL — either add ingress rule for /i/* → backend, or rename endpoint to /api/i/:token. Without this the magic-link invite flow is unusable for demo attendees.
Consider expanding gate verify rate-limit window from 5/15min or adding an allowlist for known preview testers.
Update PRD.md with correct tRPC procedure names (gate.create not gate.createInvite; needsEnrichment returns list not {ids}).
critical_code_review_comments: server/index.ts is 1168 lines — well over 700-line threshold. Consider extracting: gate middleware, meta injection, invite handler, scheduled handlers into separate modules.

The gate wall design (require 'Accept: text/html' to enforce redirect) is elegant but means non-browser clients (curl without header, monitoring bots) will silently get 200s instead of 302s. Confirmed this is intentional — API and asset requests should not be gated.
Rate limiter uses in-memory buckets (per pod). Multi-replica deploys would let attackers dodge it by hitting different pods. OK for preview, needs Redis-backed limiter for prod.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_demo_e2e.py (new — 42 tests covering gate wall, publicPreview, tRPC endpoints, sitemap, sample vintage log variants, health, invite flow)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Rate limiter blocks /api/gate/verify after ~5 attempts per IP in 15 min. If tests fail on gate unlock with 429, that's the reason — wait 15 min or run from a different IP. The /i/:token ingress bug is the ONLY real bug found; every other demo-critical surface is green. Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_demo_e2e.py has 42 tests; run with API_URL=https://private-tutor-2.preview.emergentagent.com.
rca of the issue: INVITE MAGIC-LINK BUG — Reproduction: (1) POST /api/gate/verify to get cookie, (2) POST /api/trpc/gate.create with {label,expiresInDays}, (3) copy token from response, (4) anonymously GET https://private-tutor-2.preview.emergentagent.com/i/<token> with Accept: text/html — expected 302 + ow_gate cookie, got 200 HTML. Confirmed working on http://localhost:8001/i/<token> (302 + cookie). Root cause: Kubernetes ingress in this preview environment routes /api/* to backend:8001 and everything else to frontend:3000, so the Express /i/:token handler never sees the request. Mitigation options: (a) add ingress rule matching ^/i/ → backend, (b) rename endpoint to /api/i/:token and update mintInviteUrl(). Option (b) is more portable across deployment topologies.
